texts: Ask your assistant for an avatar and it renders in the chat: live, rotatable, idling, with a paste-anywhere embed beside it. npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/avatar-mcp
The avatar is live in the conversation: rotate it, zoom it, watch it idle, without leaving the chat. All three tools are free and read-only.
Hosts without MCP Apps support still get a rendered preview image and a one-tap live embed, so the tool degrades gracefully everywhere.

issues.problem: The frame shows the package title card, install command, and tool chips, which supports the claim, but it does not show the avatar rendered inside a chat, which is the central visual promise of the post.
issues.fix: Optional: capture a frame showing render_avatar's interactive MCP App output inside a chat window for a stronger demonstration. The current shot is accurate and from the live route, so this is not required.
